days.title: This is my wiener dog named Gary. This costume seemed fitting
days.author: angeliquewysock
days.text:
This is my wiener dog named Gary

This costume seemed fitting
days.blurb: A wiener dog named Gary, dressed as Gary the snail: pink spiral shell on his back, googly-eyed stalks on his head. He's holding his snout high and wearing the whole thing with remarkable dignity.

days.title: Land seal hunting for preys 🦭
days.author: Pretty_Fishing5849
days.blurb: A dapple doxie in a bright orange harness goes full land seal on the beach, caught mid-pounce with one ear flipped inside out and mouth wide open. The freshly dug crater of sand behind it says the hunt is going great.
